Class ReportDao

java.lang.Object
sakaboba.dao.ReportDao
public class ReportDao extends Object
Loads read-only manager reports from PostgreSQL using the fixed ReportType list. Each call owns and closes its connection, statement and result set. Returned ReportData is disconnected from JDBC and safe to pass to the Swing panel. Database calls are blocking and must run outside the Swing event dispatch thread.

Date ranges include both endpoints, using local midnight timestamps with an exclusive upper bound at the next day's midnight. Product usage is an estimate based on current recipes, not a historical inventory movement ledger.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public ReportData run(ReportType type, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Executes a report with bound date parameters and derives its table columns. For ReportType.X_REPORT, both supplied dates are ignored and replaced by today in the JVM's default time zone. This call never resets sales.
      Parameters:
      type - report to execute; must not be null
      start - inclusive first sales date; required except for the X-report
      end - inclusive last sales date; required except for the X-report
      Returns:
      column metadata and rows in the query's order; sales dates become LocalDate values and ingredient quantities are not marked as currency
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the report is missing or a date range is missing, reversed, or ends at LocalDate.MAX
      DataAccessException - if connecting to the database or executing the query fails
